description_expanded: Overview5.0(5 reviews)PROMINENCE – Recovery Room Luxury Townhome | Heated Community Pool | Sleeps 9 DESCRIPTION Welcome to the Recovery Room, a stylish and comfortable 3-bedroom retreat located in the Prominence North community and just steps from The Big Chill. This spacious corner-unit townhome offers relaxing wooded views, upscale finishes, and easy access to two resort-style pools and all the fun of 30A. OUTDOOR LIVING & BEACH ACCESS Lounge on the spacious deck overlooking an expanse of trees or enjoy the nearby community pools. One heated in Spring and Fall. Extra perks include complimentary use of four bikes, beach chairs/toys in the garage. HOME FEATURES 3 bedrooms | 2 full + 1 half bathrooms | Sleeps 9 King primary suite with walk-in shower Guest rooms with queen bed and bunk w/ trundle (twin over full + full trundle) Gourmet kitchen with Electrolux appliances Spacious living area with Smart TV and comfy seating Garage stocked with beach chairs and toys DINING & ENTERTAINMENT Across from The Big Chill (shops, dining, movies, live music) Visit our beautiful white sandy beaches including Deer Lake State Park With 27 miles of bike trails, five state parks, and 15 coastal dune lakes, there is plenty to feed your appetite for adventure! WHY STAY HERE? Across from The Big Chill, a popular destination for restaurants, boutique shops, and entertainment Family-friendly layout with space to spread out World-class live music, family-friendly movies, sporting events, and a large selection of dining options Whether you're relaxing poolside, enjoying live music at The Big Chill, or biking to the beach, the Recovery Room is your perfect 30A home base.Show less
